displayName: 俯卧撑状态保持｜高位平板(侧面)

metrics.hint_bad: Body line is not straight: tighten the core and glutes, avoid sagging or lifting the hips, and keep the shoulders, hips, and ankles aligned.
Shoulders are not stacked over the wrists: shift the body weight so the shoulders sit directly above the wrists.
Elbows are bending: keep the arms as straight as possible for support, without forcing excessive hyperextension.
Good-form hold ratio is low: do not sacrifice posture just to hold longer; time with a sagging lower back does not count as effective hold time.
Core is unstable: the body is moving too much; stay still and firm like a solid plank.
